LanguageData.APM_Mech_Siren.label: Siren
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Siren.description: Taking advantage of the fact that mechanoids have a psychic presence, the siren mechanoid has the ability to lure colonists toward itself, exposing them to the heat of battle. When controlled via a mechanitor, this mech can provide a mood and recreation boost to those nearby.
